fps: we traced the rest of the smilers to an old train station. looks like this is the supply chain link we should sever. we're going to pack you up with some explosives and send you there to destroy their munitions and drug supplies. oh, we also learned of this freak called chef. he has a penchant for cutting up anything with a pulse and trying to cook it. eliminate him for a bonus.
FPS:
我们追查到「笑脸」剩下的人躲在一个旧火车站。看来该切断这条供货链了。

我们会给你带上炸药，把你送过去炸掉他们的弹药和毒品补给。

对了，我们还查到有个叫「厨师」的疯子，特别喜欢把任何还有脉搏的东西切了拿去煮。干掉他有奖金。

fps: an abandoned motel that was occupied by some squatters up until recently. says in the files you retrieved from the farmhouse that this place belongs to "bon-bon", whoever that is from the outside, this motel seems to be a lily-pad. the smilers ferry drugs from the motel into the city, though we're unsure if drugs are produced there, too whatever the case may be, your orders are to destroy any and all drug-related equipment, to find information that'll reveal more about their places of operation, and to kill "bon-bon"
FPS:
一间废弃汽车旅馆，直到最近还被一群占房的人住着。从农舍拿到的文件里说，这地方属于"邦邦"，谁知道那是谁。

从外面看，这旅馆像片荷叶。笑脸的人把毒品从旅馆运进城里，不过我们不确定毒品是不是也在那儿生产。

不管怎样，命令是摧毁所有和毒品有关的设备、找到能暴露他们更多据点位置的信息，并干掉"邦邦"。

fps:
Turns out those Smilers weren't smart enough to make their own explosives. Go figure. 

From what clean-up found at the train station, the Smilers have some ties to another gang called the Jumpsuits. 

Anyways, we're sending you to one of their recent spots; a quiet suburb that they took over and trashed. 

Orders are to find the schematics for the landmines they're making, and to eliminate a guy called Killswitch. He seems to be one of their ringleaders. If you manage to kill everyone there, you'll get a bonus.
FPS:
看来那些笑脸笨到连炸药都得自己做。真是想不到。

从火车站清理现场找到的东西看，笑脸和另一个叫「连体服」的帮派有来往。

总之，我们派你去他们最近拿下的一个据点；一片被他们占了、糟蹋过的安静郊区。

命令是：找到他们造地雷的图纸，干掉一个叫「断电」的家伙。他像是头目之一。要是你把那儿的人全杀了，有额外奖金。

fps:

Anyways, as of now, we're unclear why the Yuppies have built up such a strong fortification there. Your job is to find out what's going on so we can figure out how to burn it all down.
